caseNameFull: United States v. Winebrenner and United States v. Loose
attorneys: Solicitor General Fahy for the United States., Messrs. John G. Madden and Haveth E. Mau for respondent in No. 1150.

opinions.text:
Petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Black is of opinion that certiorari should be granted.

Reported below: 147 F. 2d 322.
